title: Climate change refers to long-term shifts in temperatures and weather...
description: Climate change refers to long-term shifts in temperatures and weather patterns. Such shifts can be natural, due to changes in the sun’s activity or large volcanic eruptions. But since the 1800s, human activities have been the main driver of climate change, primarily due to the burning of fossil fuels like coal, oil and gas improper dispose of plastics etc. Burning fossil fuels generates greenhouse gas emissions that act like a blanket wrapped around the Earth, trapping the sun’s heat and raising temperatures as it has been critically noticed temperatures have rapidly increased in several countries  across the world eg. south Sudan Uganda etc. which is really a world threat. The main greenhouse gases that are causing climate change include carbon dioxide and methane. These come from using gasoline for driving a car or coal for heating a building, for example. Clearing land and cutting down forests can also release carbon dioxide. Agriculture, oil and gas operations are major sources of methane emissions. Energy, industry, transport, buildings, agriculture and land use are among the main sectors causing greenhouse gases. So with immediate effect from now lets unite and fight against climate change in order to save the world to be a better home for us and a thousands of generations that will arise.
